title: Dieci di Balìa to Machiavelli at the French court, cipher letters of 17 and 22 August 1510 (BNCF Carte Machiavelli V/134, V/125; Unsolved Catalogue 2911, 2910)

documents.shelfmark: BNCF, Autografi Palatini, Carte Machiavelli V/134, f. 1r (old f. 230)
documents.route: Dieci di Balìa, Florence -> Niccolò Machiavelli at the court of Louis XII

plaintext.source: No decipherment on or with the leaf; not printed in Opere VI (1877); ASF Dieci register not checked

transcription.notes: Single pass from BNCF Teca images of about 900 px; several glyph pairs of the key cannot be told apart at that size.

documents.shelfmark: BNCF, Autografi Palatini, Carte Machiavelli V/125 (old f. 252), enclosure of V/124
documents.route: Dieci di Balìa, Florence -> Niccolò Machiavelli at the court of Louis XII

plaintext.source: Hypothesis only: a ciphered summary of the Dieci letter of 18 Aug 1510 (Opere VI pp. 72-74); not tested

transcription.notes: Not transcribed beyond a first look at line 1.

system.summary: Florentine chancery cipher of 1510 for the orators in France and Rome: alphabet with homophones, nulls, syllable signs, double-letter signs and a few dictions (BNCF Carte Machiavelli VI/82 c. 2r).
system.notes: Several signs differ only by a small circle or dot (r / r with circle, q / q with circle), which the 900 px images do not always show.

prior_solution.where: The period key, BNCF Carte Machiavelli VI/82 c. 2r ('Roma & Francia da scrivere'); no decipherment of V/134 or V/125

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout chose the target from the catalogue and set the rules (frozen key and pre-registration before the held-out test, two blind transcription passes, prior-work search); AI agents transcribed, decoded, measured and wrote up.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Machiavelli's decipherments I/80-I/81 as the clear of V/134 or V/125: rejected on length and content.
Period key VI/82 c. 2r found in the same collection and transcribed (key/KEY.tsv, frozen).
Pre-registered single test on V/131 lines 1-7 (333 signs, two blind passes) against Opere VI p. 89: 0.660 against a best of 0.303 for 200 permuted keys; the 0.85 threshold is not met.
V/134 decoded in part in a single pass: Giovanni Girolami, the Venetian galleys, Genoa, the fleet, Marcantonio.

validation.notes: Pre-registered held-out test of the period key: 0.660 vs best control 0.303 (margin 0.356), below the 0.85 threshold, so the key is reported as partial. docs/_validate.py was not run.

outcome.method_basis: Period key BNCF Carte Machiavelli VI/82 c. 2r applied to the undeciphered letters of August 1510.

gaps.item: V/134: single transcription pass at 900 px; most lines read only in fragments

texts.summary: Giovanni Girolami has arrived; news of the Venetian galleys, of Genoa and the fleet, from Rome, of lances and Marcantonio's troops.
texts.note: Single pass, decoded in part; read_share is an estimate.

reading_review.note: Fragments read as sense (Giovanni Girolami clean; 'in porto et da Genova', 'intendiamo che', Marcantonio); most of each line unread. Kept as read in part.

credits.note: Brice Dudout, Europe chiffrée (https://bdudout.github.io/europe-chiffree/): key identification, pre-registered test, partial reading
